source_units.text: I keep losing my place in origami diagrams.
Give me a study sequence for recognizing the folds.
Even if a day has several short sessions, their combined length must stay within 65 minutes.
Cover these exact topic labels: "Valley Folds", "Mountain Folds", "Reverse Folds".
Give each one at least 10 minutes over the whole plan.
Finish all scheduled study no later than 2027-02-06, inclusive.
Give "Reverse Folds" at least 35 minutes in total; this is a firm extra requirement.
